title: A short list of what changed when you come back
text: When you sign in after being away, the Dashboard now shows the changes we made while you were gone.
youCan: Open the full list any time to see everything we have changed.

title: A status page
text: There is now a status page that shows whether sign-in and the data cleaning engine are answering, and lists any problem we are working on.
youCan: If something feels slow or stops working, check the status page before you retry.

title: A help chat in the corner
text: A small help chat now sits in the corner of the website. It answers questions about features, plans and privacy from the text of our website and the in-app documentation. It cannot see your account or your data.
youCan: Ask it how a feature works, or open the full documentation.
